# Mamba
![](/images/mamba_logo.png){style="width:200px; border-radius:5px" fig-align="center"}

## Program installation

Mamba is a reimplementation of conda. It is a great tool for installing bioinformatic packages including R packages.

Mamba github: [https://github.com/mamba-org/mamba](https://github.com/mamba-org/mamba)

The best way to use Mamba is to install Miniforge. It has both Conda and Mamba commands.

Miniforge installation: [https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge](https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge)

Mamba guide: [https://mamba.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/mamba.html](https://mamba.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_guide/mamba.html)

## MaAsLin3

To create the mamba environment `maaslin3` run the below commands in your bash. You will need to have installed mamba first.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#maaslin3
#create conda env
conda create -n maaslin3
#activate
conda activate maaslin3
#Install required software
conda install conda-forge::r-base=4.5.3 conda-forge::r-irkernel \
conda-forge::r-biocmanager=1.30.27 conda-forge::r-tidyverse=2.0.0 \
conda-forge::r-plotly=4.12.0 conda-forge::r-htmlwidgets=1.6.4 \
conda-forge::r-rcolorbrewer=1.1.3 conda-forge::r-scales=1.4.0 \
bioconda::bioconductor-biocparallel=1.44.0 conda-forge::r-dt=0.34 \
biconda::bioconductor-maaslin3=1.2.0
```

## jupyter
![](/images/jupyter_logo.png){style="width:150px; background: white; border-radius:5px" fig-align="center"}

If you are running this on your own computer you can use RStudio. However, you can also use `Jupyter-notebook` if you are using an HPC or prefer it.

If using bash you will need to create an environment with Jupyter-notebook. Ensure you are in the (base) mamba environment.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda create -n jupyter
conda activate jupyter
conda install -c anaconda jupyter
conda deactivate
```

To run `Jupyter-notebook` with your `maaslin3` environment you can run the following.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#Activate your maaslin3 env if it is not activate already
mamba activate r_community
#Run jupyter-notebook (may be a slightly different path)
#~/miniforge/envs/jupyter/bin/jupyter-notebook
```

## Metadata exploration

To create the mamba environment `meta_explore` run the below commands in your bash. You will need to have installed mamba first.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
conda create -n meta_explore
conda activate meta_explore
conda install bioconda::bioconductor-variancepartition conda-forge::r-irkernel \
conda-forge::r-tidyverse
```
